description: According to a press release, the newly introduced courses include Artificial Intelligence (AI) Programming Assistant, Drone Pilot, Solar Technician (Electrical), Information Technology, Mechanic Electric Vehicle, Advanced CNC Machining, Additive Manufacturing Technician (3D Printing), etc.
body_lead: Gandhinagar (Gujarat) [India], June 7 (ANI): In a major push to align technical education with emerging industrial trends and future job markets, the Gujarat government's Labour, Skill Development and Employment department has introduced a range of "New-Age" courses in Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across the state.
